summary.executiveSummaryReference: The team rehearsed the webinar opening, handovers, Q&A flow and contingency plan. They agreed that Priya would handle the opening, housekeeping, handovers and close; Tom would keep his intro and answers tight; Nadia would manage questions and timing prompts; and Callum would handle technical safety-net duties, recording and the closing slide. A short warm-up was agreed for 08:30 before the live 11:00 session.
